Technical and design decisions:
1. Adopt Spring Cloud Netflix Eureka as the service discovery implementation for all Eureka registration requirements (U1, U4).
2. Define custom Spring SPI interfaces for Admin backend operations, with adapter implementations for existing Admin backends to support the controller refactoring (U2).
3. Use Spring Boot Actuator as the primary metrics collection source for s-c-s modules, with Spring Integration channel metrics as a supplemental source where applicable (U3).
4. Use Redis as the default persistence store for module metrics, leveraging Spring Boot's built-in metrics export functionality with a 5-second default snapshot interval (U7).
5. Ported FTP modules will follow the existing s-c-s module structure and use the standard module launcher pattern to ensure consistency with existing source modules (U6).
6. GitHub Actions will be used as the CI/CD platform for all build, test, and Docker image publishing workflows (U5, U8).
7. The module-launcher Docker image will be published to the existing springcloud organization DockerHub repository as specified (U8).
